name: Sabotage
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature or object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as dispel magic except it can only be a targeted dispel. Additionally, the target of the dispel takes damage equal to the caster level of the spell Dispelled. If the target is a summoned creature or a construct, instead of the dispel effect, they instead take 1d8 damage per caster level of the spell used to summon them. Constructs cannot be immune to this spell.
